clusters.reason: All four rows are disabled workshop.submit fills from the same submitted SwiftUI component in P1 light and P2 dark, before selection or after replacement clears selection. The D0 source paints the correct palette.disabled inside the Button label but applies PlainButtonStyle() and .disabled(selected == nil) around that label. Native original and common D0 screenshots show coherent disabled state and the same surface transformation in both themes; the approved bridge only adapts fixtures/callbacks, and the common observer host does not apply opacity/button style to this component. Original raw pixel strips reproduce #CFCDC5 rather than #AAA99F in P1 and #33474C rather than #52666A in P2. Enabled states do not belong to the failed universe. These are repeated state/theme manifestations of one shared component-owned disabled rendering path, not four independent bugs. The exact internal framework alpha mechanism is inferred rather than instrumented; that limitation does not separate the demonstrated shared rendering cause into independent state or theme bugs. No FINAL repair evidence or other grouping was used.
